verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a cloud platform like Azure, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents versioned APIs or a deprecation policy. The REST API docs cited cover only curl usage, client libraries and Entra registration, none of which addresses versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
